themes.title: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation's Bold Direction
themes.summary: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation's director, Naoki Hamaguchi, is pushing the franchise beyond traditional JRPG boundaries, emphasizing a grand finale with open-world design and a commitment to the series' legacy   .
